Messages.Author: tobinator
Messages.Body:
So we're in a JOL game.

Blood Weakens is in play, I have 7 cards in hand, and I just reacted
with Ira with a Spirit's Touch. I did not replace (from BW) but I did
draw an additional (Ira) giving me 7 cards in hand. Does the BW
effectively lower my hand size forcing me to discard down to 6? My gut
tells me so...

Relevant Card Text:
Name: Blood Weakens
"Cards that {a minion plays that} require any Disciplines to play are
not replaced until the end of the current action or until any
Methuselah's hand is empty (whichever comes first)."

Name: Ira Rivers
"When Ira plays a card that requires Auspex, you may draw an additional
card from your library (discard down to your hand size afterward)."

Thanks,
Tobin
-tpl

minion. A disciplineless intercept (Trusting in that Sixth Sense) or
damage prevent (Trusting in your Gut's fortitude).

I won't go so far as to stat the cards up however they would probably
grant +1 intercept or 2 damage prevent.
